fo.sub.zh: 把这台电脑上装着成片分集的文件夹（ep1.mp4、ep2.mp4 …）导入为剧集，导入后即可上传到 CrazyDramas。
fo.sub.en: A folder of finished episodes on this computer (ep1.mp4, ep2.mp4 …) becomes a title, ready for Upload to CrazyDramas.

fo.adminOnly.zh: 只有管理员可以从这台电脑导入文件夹。
fo.adminOnly.en: Only an administrator can import a folder from this computer.

fo.picking.hint.zh: 文件夹选择窗口已在这台电脑上打开（如果没看到，请查看任务栏）。
fo.picking.hint.en: The folder window is open on this computer (check the taskbar if you don't see it).

fo.ignored.zh: {n} 个视频文件名里没有集数，已跳过：{files}
fo.ignored.en: {n} video file(s) with no episode number were left out: {files}

fo.noPoster.zh: 文件夹里没有 poster.jpg：系列会先不带海报创建，之后可以再设置。
fo.noPoster.en: No poster.jpg in the folder: the series is created without one, and you can set it later.

fo.existing.zh: 已导入为「{name}」：再次导入只会复制有变化的文件。
fo.existing.en: Already imported as {name}: importing again copies only the files that changed.

fo.running.zh: 正在复制第 {n} 集，共 {total} 集…

fo.done.zh: 完成：新增 {added} 集，更新 {updated} 集，未变 {unchanged} 集。
